newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-MATTHAEUS TO MISS KEY BAYERN CLASH AT ROSTOCK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATTHAEUS TO MISS KEY BAYERN CLASH AT ROSTOCK.

text.p: Germany's most capped player Lothar Matthaeus has been forced to pull out of Bayern Munich's important German league clash at Hansa Rostock on Friday because of a thigh strain.
The veteran libero, who hurt his right leg in a friendly nine days ago, was unable to train on Thursday, the league leaders said.

Defender Thomas Helmer is expect to take over the libero role as Bayern bid to protect their one-point lead over Bayer Leverkusen in the last three games of the season. Matthaeus hopes to return against VfB Stuttgart next week.
"There is no point him playing because he needs complete rest for two days so he can be fit for the Stuttgart game," club spokesman Markus Hoerwick said.
